evidence: CAItems registers copper_wire with Item::new and copper_spool with WireSpool::new.
WireSpool.useOn requires IWireNode and connects the two stored positions using IWireNode.connect.
No native CreateAddition advancements are bundled. Inventory is an explicit preparation objective, not proof of successful wiring.
migration: No IDs or advancement path changed. Earned quest completion is not revoked by these files. Unfinished players must acquire or update inventory with a copper spool; needs game verification.
